Ramadan Project

Ramadan is a month of fasting, worship and generosity. Through this project, your support reaches families in need in Nepal with food and essentials during the blessed month.

Support this projectAsk on WhatsApp

What your support can cover

Needs change through the year. Ask our team what is needed most right now.

Staple food for a family’s suhoor and iftar through the month.

Shared iftar for fasting people in local communities and mosques.

Food packs

Staple food helps families prepare suhoor and iftar throughout Ramadan. Contact our team for current package contents and the families you would like to support.

The 2026 field photos show food package distribution in Bara, Parsa and Rautahat.

Support food packs Ask on WhatsApp
☾

Iftar meals

Shared iftar brings fasting people together in local communities and mosques. You can help support meals for individuals and families during Ramadan.

Our 2026 field update reports around 200–300 people breaking their fast with us each day during Ramadan.

Support iftar meals Ask on WhatsApp
✦

Eid support

Eid support helps families in need share in the joy of Eid with essential assistance. Ask our team about current needs and the support arrangements available.

Contact our team before giving so your support can be directed to the current Eid needs.

Support Eid assistance Ask on WhatsApp
♡

Zakat and sadaqah

Zakat assistance supports eligible families in Nepal with essential needs. Sadaqah can also support this project. Tell our team which type of giving you intend so it is recorded correctly.

For Zakat, include “Zakat” in your payment reference and inform our team after the transfer.

Give ZakatGive Sadaqah Ask on WhatsApp

How to give to this project

  1. 1Choose the amount you would like to give. You can ask us about current needs first.
  2. 2Transfer to one of our official accounts, with your name and the purpose in the payment reference.
  3. 3Send us a message after the transfer so we can confirm it and record it for this purpose.
  4. 4Follow our field updates on the home page, or ask us for a report.
